full_name: International Symposium on Space Technology and Science
organizer: Japan Society for Aeronautical and Space Sciences (JSASS) and the ISTS Organizing Committee; often held jointly with NSAT (Nano-Satellite Symposium) or other meetings
frequency: Biennial (odd years; the 33rd ran in Feb-Mar 2022)

submission.type: Online abstract submission, then a full paper upload; 'No Paper, No Presentation' policy
submission.typical_abstract_deadline: About 7-8 months before the event (Oct-Dec of the previous year)
submission.notes: 36th (2027): abstract submission opened 17 Sep 2026, abstract deadline 17 Dec 2026, paper deadline 17 Jun 2027. 35th (2025): abstract deadline 5 Nov 2024, full paper deadline 30 May 2025 (TBD at the time). 34th (2023): abstract deadline 31 Oct 2022, paper upload 30 Apr 2023.

editions.venue: Himegin Hall (Ehime Prefectural Citizens' Culture Center)

editions.notes: Cross-checked 2026-10-16: confirmed all-online format (official site: symposium style "all-online", nominal host Beppu, Oita); city kept as "Beppu (online)".

Cross-checked 2026-10-16: abstract_deadline changed 2024-11-05 -> 2024-11-19; official What's New post (5 Nov 2024) extended the Call for Papers to 19 Nov 2024 (original 5 Nov per CFP https://ists.ne.jp/the35th/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/Call-for-PapersISTS_A4_0521-1.pdf).

notes: No ISTS edition was held in 2014; the 29th was in 2013. The 36th (2027) is joint with the 8th TiS International Conference on Tethers in Space. The ists.ne.jp home page confirmed on 2026-10-16 that abstract submission opened 17 Sep 2026; no extension is mentioned. The 33rd (2022) was all-online despite the Beppu/Oita branding. 2019 Fukui: the venue is not verified, and the year comes from the source post date (July 2019) plus the Yamaguchi University and Tokyo University of Science calendars. 2017: the Matsuyama city report (in Japanese) names Himegin Hall, and some secondary reports name the Ehime Prefectural Citizens' Culture Center; these are believed to be the same building, but that is not verified from an official source. Abstract deadlines for 2015-2019 were not found.
